inputs.frame: the two-storey brick corner building with the mural, on its Austin street
inputs.idea: Image 1 is a crop of our Austin street scene (take 04): the two-storey brick corner building with the big painted mural, across the street, left of centre, live oaks behind it, late-afternoon sun. Keep this exact building in this exact place: its footprint, two storeys, height, angle to the street, the camera and the light; it must still sit in that street. Develop its architecture in this studio's idiom: brick, windows, shopfront, signage, cornice, the mural's wall. Real, buildable, an Austin corner building, not a new object. Owner, verbatim: "the blue tile building is terrible. the architecture studio needs to be driven for a better look on that - the original brick building generation is much better"
